proposals.evidence: Turner divasa explicitly gives Lahnda/Punjabi deh/dĩh/ḍẽh day/sun, Awankari dḕõ sun, Jaunsari dūs and western Gujarati/Marathi dīs/day forms. These dī(h)/dīs sun responses are compared with that family, preserving nasalization and retroflex spellings. Turner notes possible crossing with ahar and regional diffusion; the n-final dina family is not conflated with it.
